name: find
description: Ask's search row (row: the field it is given filling it), and the Timeline's search (pill, v4 C1): the bar with the magnifier, the field, its clear control and the switch (keyword or by meaning), the found line under it; sticky as the list's running head, it floats as a pill once the list scrolls under it.

form.description: row: Ask's search row (it retires with C2). pill (v4 C1, explore timeline-jump-arrival f-wash-and-frame): the Timeline's search, written by the section itself. Sticky as the list's running head (top --aj-s-find-top, from the container's 1200 one line below the page top, level with the side card); stuck, it narrows from both sides on the desktop and rounds to half its height everywhere, lifted with its glow, its found line a small tag under it.

mode.description: The search the switch has chosen: keyword (the words typed, placeholder "Search your journal") or meaning (in any words, placeholder "What was it about?", the switch on). The pill only.

status.description: idle: the found line says how many days (or nothing). searching: the found line says so. failed: the found line says the search did not run, with Try again. The app sets it at run time; a page renders it for a state. The pill only.

stuck.description: Draw it floating (a comp state; at run time find.js decides from the scroll). The pill only.

flow.description: The pill only: in the flow instead of sticky (data-flow). The page sets it where it scrolls under a pinned header that no script measures (Timeline's numbered comps below desktop).

query.description: The words in the field; the clear control shows only when there are some.

found.description: The found line: "3 days with “sleep”.", "3 days about “sleep”, in any words.", "Searching your journal.", or the failure line. Written by the page from its data; at run time the app writes it (hook found).

copy.description: { label, hint, meaningHint, meaning, clear, retry }: the field's name, its two placeholders, the switch's word, the clear control's name, the retry's word. The approved copy is the default.

children.description: The row form's search field. The pill writes its own.

states.default: yes: the bar at rest, empty, the placeholder showing
states.hover: n/a: a section is not a control; its controls carry their own
states.focus-visible: yes: the product focus ring round the whole bar while the field has focus
states.disabled: n/a: the search is always available
states.selected: yes: by meaning (the switch on, its placeholder); and stuck (floating over the list as a pill)
states.loading: yes: searching (the found line says so)
states.error: yes: failed (the found line says the search did not run, with Try again)
states.empty: yes: nothing typed: no clear control, the found line empty. No matches is the record's state, not the search's

events.search: the words, the mode or a retry asked for a search (bubbling; detail: { query, mode }): the app runs it, sets data-status and fills the found line

a11y.role: search (the pill); the row has none, the field carries its label
a11y.keyboard: Tab to the field, the clear control (when shown), the switch, and Try again (when shown); Space on the switch
a11y.labels: the field: "Search your journal"; the clear control: "Clear search"; the switch: its word, "By meaning", role switch; the found line is a polite live region

responsive.1200: the pill pins one line below the page top (--s9 less --s4), level with the side card; stuck, it narrows to 480px, 44px tall, its controls 36px
responsive.all: below 1200, stuck, it keeps its width and height and only rounds

changelog.change: The pill form (v4 C1): the Timeline's search, sticky as the list's running head; find.js; the states searching and failed; data-module on both forms. The found line's widths round to whole pixels (Try again starts on one), Try again never breaks, and a failure that takes two lines grows the block.

--aj-s-find-top removed (nothing set it: below 1200 the pill sticks in the reader, which starts under the header). Option flow: in the flow instead of sticky, for a page that scrolls under a pinned header with no script (Timeline's numbered comps).
v4 round 10: the bar's focus is its own border at 2px in --block, drawn inward, not a ring outside it.

places.mode: the switch, after the divider; from 1200, stuck, the section sets its height to 36px (--aj-c-button-switch-h)
places.retry: Try again in the found line, shown only while the search failed

behaviour.script: find.js, the pill only, inside its root: shows the clear control while the field holds words and clears it; the switch flips aria-checked, data-mode and the placeholder; any of these, and Try again, dispatch search. Watches the scroll (its own scroller, or the page) and sets data-stuck while the pill floats at its sticky top.

data-mode.description: The switch's choice. Rendered from mode.

data-status.description: The search the app is running: idle (done, or none), searching, failed. Rendered from status.

data-stuck.description: Floating over the list: the page has scrolled past the pill's resting place. Rendered from stuck for a comp.

hooks.found: the found line's text: the app writes the count, "Searching your journal." or the failure line
hooks.data-hint-keyword: on the root: the keyword placeholder, which find.js puts back when the switch turns off
hooks.data-hint-meaning: on the root: the by-meaning placeholder, which find.js puts in when the switch turns on
